_comment: Controls the email alerts only. The website itself reads nothing from this file. Edit it here on GitHub; the next scan picks it up.

alerts._mode: all = every stock that crosses into the bottom of its channel. watchlist = only the symbols listed below.
alerts._timeframes: Which channels to watch: 1mo (monthly), 1wk, 1d. Monthly only is the quiet default; adding 1d will alert far more often.
alerts._filters: Applied on top of mode, so you only hear about crossings worth looking at.
